spec.text: Image 1 is the woman's character model sheet; image 2 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Early morning in a small, cozy apartment in Yonghe, New Taipei. The woman stands by the window tying her hair back, her tan crossbody bag on the table beside her; through the window, far away in soft morning haze, Taipei 101 rises above the city. Warm morning light. Every character must be rendered as a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, with faces, glasses, hairstyles and outfits identical to their references, never as a flat 2D drawing. Mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
